resolved_blockers: Phase 01 freezes measurable feasibility and release budgets before code.
Candidate A requires reproducible ingress-specific failure against frozen targets, no userspace correction, and two Law-1 confirmations.
Phase 03 blocks Phase 04 until scheduler coexistence, request/reply correlation, bounded wakeups, heartbeat/watchdog, and network polling are prototyped.
Phase 02 consumes DICE identity Phase P04 as the single stable identity lifecycle owner and disables public/remote until key lifecycle is pinned.
Export registry authority is init/supervisor-provisioned, broker read-only at runtime, atomically replaced, version-validated, and fail-closed.
Phase 04 scopes at-most-one local dispatch to authenticated retention window and returns Indeterminate after expiry/eviction for non-idempotent requests.
Typed client API ownership is assigned to ostd with LocalEndpoint, RemoteEndpoint, and CellEndpoint union; no libs/api or kernel ABI by default.
Error taxonomy, retry mapping, and no-evict-in-flight are Phase 04/05 entry gates; Phase 07 only operationalizes metrics and failover.
open_gates: User approval of Candidate B before implementation starts.
Capture Phase 01 budgets and measured broker baseline before code.
Phase 02 must pin exact key path, permissions, clone handling, lost-key recovery, and export registry path/encoding.
Phase 03 prototype must pass before Phase 04.
No COMPLETE status until relay and LAN isolated two-node oracles pass with retained evidence.
No production readiness claim from this planning pass.
